resources.string: Enable motion blur for this project
Position, scale, and rotation keyframes blur the clip’s placement. Loops, jump cuts, transitions, and still-image clips can show a sharp preview. Filmed-video motion analysis is planned separately.
Live preview supports a single video overlay at normal speed with Normal blend. Masks, chroma key, track mattes, and clip effects can leave it sharp.
Preview supports ordinary animated pictures. Linked pictures, corner pins, custom pivots, and effect or transition treatments can leave the picture sharp.
Preview supports plain animated titles. Linked, styled, warped, and preset-animated titles can remain sharp.
Preview supports a single ordinary animated sprite with directly keyed cells. Avatar rigs, preset sequences, and mixed overlay stacks can remain sharp.
Select a clip, picture, title, or sprite to set motion blur.
